title: Design System: Empi Proof Bench (Publisher and Launcher)

mask-black.displayName: Mask Black (alpha mask only, never painted)

pink.displayName: Electric Pink (Publisher accent; launcher default accent)

launcher-ink.displayName: Launcher Ink (label on accent, text on paper)

launcher-danger.displayName: Launcher Danger (DETENER, login errors; legibility exception)

display.purpose: Publisher pack title and empty-state heading. Never body text.

drawer-title.purpose: Activity drawer title and launcher version numerals.

wordmark.purpose: Uppercase Empi Publisher in the topbar.

body.purpose: Publisher prose and typed input text; prose capped at 62ch.

launcher-title-30.purpose: Welcome header, login options heading, settings nav header.

launcher-title-20.purpose: Version rail title. 20px is the smallest size Doto appears at in the launcher.

launcher-launch-label.purpose: The launch button label, the one Doto exception below 20px.

launcher-label.purpose: 13px labels: progress label, player name, updater title. Avenir is the launcher's existing body face and stays.

launcher-help.purpose: 11px floor for help text and progress stats.

launcher-chip.purpose: 10px floor for chips and small labels.

tile-numeral.purpose: Value in each hero data tile; 19px at 520px.

title.purpose: h3, details summaries, dock step titles.

caption.purpose: Hints, facts, sub-lines, chip text, tile keys.

shadows.name: module
shadows.purpose: Publisher modules: inset top highlight and a long tinted drop shadow.

shadows.name: drawer-cast
shadows.purpose: Publisher floating activity drawer. The launcher has no shadows.

shadows.name: input-focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Publisher input focus: pink tint ring plus a pink .55 border.

motion.name: publisher-doctrine
motion.value: alive but budgeted
motion.purpose: The Publisher moves at rest within a budget; every movement says where you are, what changed or what to do next. Switch: Vivo / Tranquilo, localStorage empi.motion, data-motion on root; reduced-motion starts calm.

motion.name: publisher-fps-focused
motion.value: 24 fps (41 ms frame gap)
motion.purpose: Canvas dot ground while the window has focus.

motion.name: publisher-fps-unfocused
motion.value: 10 fps (100 ms frame gap); 0 when the tab is hidden
motion.purpose: Canvas dot ground without focus; cancelled on visibilitychange hidden.

motion.name: publisher-canvas-density
motion.value: 1 canvas pixel per CSS pixel; 45-degree hex lattice, pitch 24px
motion.purpose: Keeps raster cost flat on dense screens.

motion.name: publisher-degrade
motion.value: smoothed frame cost > 9 ms for 90 frames, or frames > 2.2x late for 45 frames: pitch +6px up to 36px, then calm
motion.purpose: Frame-cost and delivered-frame-rate degradation; the field thins out and finally stops.

motion.name: publisher-measured
motion.value: about 7-10% of one core alive, about 0% calm; canvas frame cost about 1 ms (headless Edge, software raster)
motion.purpose: Measured budget, not a guarantee on other hardware.

motion.name: publisher-animated-properties
motion.value: transform and opacity only
motion.purpose: Arrivals, springs, hover physics, pops, beats. The pre-existing tear and the arrival reveal also use clip-path (see drift).

motion.name: publisher-infinite-allowed
motion.value: skeleton pulse 1.4s steps(2) and running-job LED 1s steps(1) only
motion.purpose: All other Publisher CSS animations are finite or replayed on a timer (beat every 10 s, ambient glitch every 6-14 s, both only when focused and alive).

motion.name: ease-out
motion.value: cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1)
motion.purpose: Spring-like movement: drawer slide .5s, dialog pop .38s, toast rise .42s, ink slide .5s, card lean .4s, button lift .35s, arrivals .6s.

motion.name: spring
motion.purpose: Overshoot for everything pressable: button transform .45s, icon button .5s, switch knob .45s, chevron .4s.

motion.name: ease
motion.value: cubic-bezier(.2, .9, .2, 1)
motion.purpose: Colour and background transitions (.12s to .15s).

motion.name: ink
motion.value: paper thumb behind the current tab; transform and width .55s cubic-bezier(.34, 1.25, .64, 1)
motion.purpose: Publisher segmented tabs and sub-tabs: the sliding paper thumb, where you are. Re-placed by Life.reink on fonts ready and resize.

motion.name: arrivals
motion.value: rise-in .6s ease-out, delay calc(var(--i) * 45ms); topbar drop .6s, pipeline lift .7s
motion.purpose: Staggered entrance on load and on pack or tab change.

motion.name: pipeline-motion
motion.value: pop-mark .55s on change; beat 1.6s x2 on the current step; march .9s x4 on finished connectors
motion.purpose: What changed and what to do next.

motion.name: hover-physics
motion.value: pack card translateX(4px); button translateY(-1px) then scale(.97) on press; choice translateY(-2px); primary leans up to 6x4px toward the pointer and a 100deg highlight sweeps .8s; pressed icon button scale(1.12)
motion.purpose: Things answer the hand.

motion.name: dot-field-cues
motion.value: pointer push, click ripples (1.3s), hover halo on the hovered control, pink glow around the next action, faster while a job runs, ring through the field when a job finishes
motion.purpose: Ground responds to the person and to work.

motion.name: tear
motion.value: 260ms steps(1, end) 1; keyframes 0/15/30/45/60/80/100% translateX -3,4,-2,2,-1px with clip-path bands and text-shadow 2px red/cyan split
motion.purpose: Event glitch, both surfaces: new step, failure, pack title after selecting (Publisher); a view opening, launch button state change, updater state change, update notice (launcher).

motion.name: split
motion.value: 200ms (Publisher) / 260ms (launcher) steps(1, end) 1; text-shadow 2px/-2px/1px red and cyan only
motion.purpose: Hover flash on buttons.

motion.name: led
motion.value: 1s steps(1, end) infinite; opacity 1 to .2 at 50%
motion.purpose: 10px accent square spinner, only while a Publisher task runs.

motion.name: resolve
motion.value: radial-gradient dots on 12px pitch, dot radius = --p x 3.6px, --p 0..1
motion.purpose: Dot-progress strip in the Publisher drawer. Static raster.

motion.name: launcher-doctrine
motion.value: event-only
motion.purpose: The launcher does not move at rest. Nothing loops, no canvas, no blur, no banner breath.

motion.name: launcher-tear-triggers
motion.value: a view opens (welcome, login, login options, waiting, landing, settings title); launch button data-state changes; launcher-update indicator data-state changes; update-ready notice becomes visible
motion.purpose: Only real state changes fire empi-tear, via MutationObservers with no polling; class removed after 400 ms.

motion.name: launcher-pause
motion.value: skipped under html[data-empi-inactive]; plates hidden and tears off under html[data-empi-performance-mode]; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Respects the launcher's RAM-saving mode and pause-on-blur.

motion.name: launcher-progress
motion.value: accent dots rise in #launch_button_fill (6px pitch) while updating or launching
motion.purpose: The launch button is the progress meter; real progress, not decoration.

breakpoints.name: narrow
breakpoints.purpose: Publisher: one column, bento and form collapse, tiles two across, dock 100vw - 16px, drawer inset 6px, status module hidden, topbar 56px. Launcher: static halftone plates hidden.

breakpoints.name: tiny
breakpoints.purpose: Publisher: wordmark text hidden, version choices one column, dock buttons one line, h1 24px, tile numerals 19px.

tokens.name: dotted
tokens.purpose: Launcher dotted rules and the Publisher drawer inner rules. No longer the Publisher main separator (hairlines now).

tokens.name: pipeline-h
tokens.value: 112px (set at runtime from the measured dock height)
tokens.purpose: Reserves bottom space under the floating dock and positions the toast.

tokens.name: topbar-fill
tokens.purpose: Translucent so the living ground shows; no blur.

tokens.name: plate-mask
tokens.value: mask-image: linear-gradient(to top, #000 35%, transparent 100%), linear-gradient(to right, #000 60%, transparent 100%)
tokens.purpose: Feathers halftone plates on both surfaces and the Publisher module corner (radial-gradient(120% 120% at 100% 0, #000 0, transparent 68%)). #000 is an alpha mask stop, never painted.

tokens.name: plates
tokens.value: art/field.png 340px (bottom-left) and 320x118 rotated 180deg (top-right); Publisher: no-JS fallback only, hidden when data-motion is set; launcher: shown on views without artwork, hidden at 900px and in performance mode

tokens.name: launcher-accent
tokens.value: --empi-accent (per version, default #ff3d8b), --empi-accent-rgb, --empi-accent-contrast (#050506 or #ffffff by WCAG contrast ratio)
tokens.purpose: The one colour of the launcher, set by landing.js from the modpack's accent.

tokens.name: launcher-screens
tokens.value: images/identity/screen-bottom.png (640x360, repeat-x, bottom-left) and screen-right.png (300x640, repeat-y, right)
tokens.purpose: Black halftone dot screens over each modpack's untouched background and banner, darkening the edges where the interface is read.

tokens.name: launcher-notch
tokens.value: clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - 18px) 0, 100% 18px, 100% 100%, 0 100%); removed on focus-visible
tokens.purpose: Launch button notch, launcher only. The Publisher primary is a pill and has no notch.

tokens.name: stipple
tokens.purpose: Disabled and locked (.16 on required-mod toggles), both surfaces.

tokens.name: hatch
tokens.purpose: Optional-off share in the hatched mods bar; present but off.

tokens.name: module-corner
tokens.value: radial-gradient(circle, rgb(241 239 232 / .22) 1px, transparent 1.5px) 0 0 / 9px 9px; 46% x 64% top right; radial mask
tokens.purpose: Static halftone corner inside each module (::before, z-index -1).

assets.name: art
assets.purpose: Procedural halftone rasters from tools/publisher/scripts/make-art.js; provenance in PNG tEXt chunks. field.png is only the no-JS fallback.

assets.name: Doto
assets.purpose: Added web font of each surface.

assets.name: Avenir
assets.purpose: The launcher's existing body face; stays.

radii.name: dock
radii.purpose: Floating pipeline dock (26px on narrow screens).

radii.name: tile
radii.purpose: Data tiles, pack cards, version choices; textarea 16px.

radii.name: input
radii.purpose: Inputs, selects, mod rows, pack icons.

radii.name: pill
radii.purpose: Buttons, tabs, segmented controls, chips, health pills, entries, toasts, search, switches.

radii.name: circle
radii.purpose: Icon buttons, step numerals, stage dots, switch knobs, accent sample.

radii.name: launcher
radii.purpose: The launcher stays square by design; the two surfaces differ on corners on purpose.

components.name: Primary Pill Button (Compilar)
components.description: Publisher: the one pink action, the next pipeline step. Pill, light sweep on hover, leans toward the pointer (magnet).
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 500 13px/1 'Geist Mono','Cascadia Mono',Consolas,monospace; letter-spacing: -.005em; padding: 11px 18px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / .07); color: #f1efe8; border: 1px solid rgb(241 239 232 / .1); cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, transform .45s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); } .ds-primary { background: #ff3d8b; color: #16030c; border-color: #ff3d8b; font-weight: 700; } .ds-primary::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(100deg, transparent 32%, rgb(255 255 255 / .38) 50%, transparent 68%); transform: translateX(-130%); } .ds-primary:hover { background: #ff6aa6; border-color: #ff6aa6; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-primary:hover::before { transform: translateX(130%); transition: transform .8s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff3d8b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pill Buttons (default, paper, danger, disabled)
components.description: Publisher default pill on a faint fill; Paper is emphasis without accent (Guardar); Danger is a coral outline (Cancelar); disabled is stipple.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; gap: 10px; } .ds-b { font: 500 13px/1 'Geist Mono','Cascadia Mono',Consolas,monospace; padding: 11px 18px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / .07); color: #f1efe8; border: 1px solid rgb(241 239 232 / .1); cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, border-color .2s, transform .45s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); } .ds-b:hover:not(:disabled) { background: rgb(255 255 255 / .13); border-color: rgb(241 239 232 / .22); } .ds-b:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-paper { background: #f1efe8; color: #0b0b0d; border-color: #f1efe8; font-weight: 600; } .ds-paper:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #fff; border-color: #fff; } .ds-danger { background: transparent; color: #ff6a4d; border-color: #ff6a4d; } .ds-danger:hover:not(:disabled) { background: rgb(255 106 77 / .1); } .ds-b:disabled { color: #8b8b81; cursor: not-allowed; background-color: #111114; background-image: repeating-conic-gradient(rgb(241 239 232 / .14) 0% 25%, transparent 0% 50%); background-size: 3px 3px; } .ds-b:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff3d8b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Icon Button (circle)
components.description: Circular 38px icon button; pressed fills paper and springs to scale 1.12 (the motion switch).
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; gap: 12px; } .ds-ic { width: 38px; height: 38px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; color: #a5a598; border: 1px solid rgb(241 239 232 / .1); cursor: pointer; transition: transform .5s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), background .2s, color .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-ic:hover { background: rgb(255 255 255 / .08); color: #f1efe8; border-color: rgb(241 239 232 / .22); } .ds-on, .ds-on:hover { background: #f1efe8; color: #0b0b0d; border-color: #f1efe8; transform: scale(1.12); } .ds-ic:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff3d8b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Publisher 12px-radius field on a translucent well; typed text is Segoe; focus is a pink border with a 3px pink tint ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 240px; box-sizing: border-box; font: 14px/1.5 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; color: #f1efe8; background: rgb(6 6 7 / .62); border: 1px solid rgb(241 239 232 / .1); border-radius: 12px; min-height: 42px; padding: 10px 14px; caret-color: #ff3d8b; transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8b8b81; opacity: 1; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: rgb(241 239 232 / .22); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 0; border-color: rgb(255 61 139 / .55); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(255 61 139 / .12); }

components.name: Switch
components.description: Checkbox restyled as a 40 by 24 pill switch; on is paper with a dark knob that travels on the spring.
components.css: .ds-check { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 240px; padding: 11px 0; color: #f1efe8; font: 14px/1.3 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; border-top: 1px solid rgb(241 239 232 / .1); } .ds-check input { appearance: none; -webkit-appearance: none; position: relative; flex: none; width: 40px; height: 24px; margin: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / .1); border: 1px solid rgb(241 239 232 / .22); cursor: pointer; transition: background .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), border-color .25s; } .ds-check input::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; background: #a5a598; transition: transform .45s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), background .2s; } .ds-check input:checked { background: #f1efe8; border-color: #f1efe8; } .ds-check input:checked::before { transform: translateX(16px); background: #0b0b0d; } .ds-check input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff3d8b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Tabs (sliding paper thumb)
components.description: Pill track with a paper thumb that slides and springs behind the current tab (top tabs and modpack sub-tabs). Current text turns dark. The real thumb position is set by JS; here it sits under the first tab.
components.css: .ds-tabs { position: relative; display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 4px; height: 42px; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(17 18 21 / .7); border: 1px solid rgb(241 239 232 / .1); } .ds-thumb { position: absolute; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; left: 4px; width: 104px; border-radius: 999px; background: #f1efe8; transition: transform .55s cubic-bezier(.34,1.25,.64,1), width .55s cubic-bezier(.34,1.25,.64,1); } .ds-tab { position: relative; z-index: 1; padding: 0 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: none; color: #a5a598; font: 500 13px/1 'Geist Mono','Cascadia Mono',Consolas,monospace; cursor: pointer; transition: color .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-tab:hover { color: #f1efe8; } .ds-tab[aria-current] { color: #0b0b0d; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff3d8b; outline-offset: 2px; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Module (with status head)
components.description: Publisher container: translucent dark panel, 1px hairline, 22px radius, inset highlight, tinted shadow and a static halftone corner. Shown as the sidebar status module with three stage dots.
components.html:
Publicacion

Compiladohace 2 min
Enviadopendiente
components.css: .ds-module { position: relative; isolation: isolate; width: 300px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 18px 20px 12px; background: rgb(17 18 21 / .76); border: 1px solid rgb(241 239 232 / .1); border-radius: 22px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .05), 0 24px 40px -28px rgb(0 0 0 / .85); } .ds-module::before { content: ''; position: absolute; z-index: -1; top: 0; right: 0; width: 46%; height: 64%; pointer-events: none; border-radius: 0 22px 0 0; background: radial-gradient(circle, rgb(241 239 232 / .22) 1px, transparent 1.5px) 0 0 / 9px 9px; -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(120% 120% at 100% 0, #000 0, transparent 68%); mask-image: radial-gradient(120% 120% at 100% 0, #000 0, transparent 68%); } .ds-module:hover { border-color: rgb(241 239 232 / .22); } .ds-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 14px; min-height: 30px; } .ds-head h2 { flex: 1; margin: 0; color: #f1efe8; font: 500 15px/1.5 'Geist Mono','Cascadia Mono',Consolas,monospace; letter-spacing: -.01em; } .ds-stage { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-stage i { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgb(241 239 232 / .22); } .ds-stage i.on { background: #f1efe8; border-color: #f1efe8; } .ds-stage i.next { border-color: #ff3d8b; background: rgb(255 61 139 / .12); } .ds-kv { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 0; border-top: 1px solid rgb(241 239 232 / .1); font: 12.5px/1.3 'Geist Mono','Cascadia Mono',Consolas,monospace; } .ds-kv span { color: #a5a598; } .ds-kv b { font-weight: 500; color: #f1efe8; }

components.name: Data Tile (with hatched share bar)
components.description: Publisher hero tile: mono key, Doto numeral, mono sub-line; the mods tile adds an 8px share bar (required solid, optional-on half, optional-off hatched).
components.html:
Mods128
70 obligatorios
components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 200px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 16px; background: rgb(255 255 255 / .04); border: 1px solid rgb(241 239 232 / .1); } .ds-k { font: 500 11.5px/1.2 'Geist Mono','Cascadia Mono',Consolas,monospace; color: #8b8b81; } .ds-v { font: 700 21px/1.1 'Doto','Cascadia Mono',Consolas,monospace; color: #f1efe8; margin-top: 2px; } .ds-sub { font: 11.5px/1.3 'Geist Mono','Cascadia Mono',Consolas,monospace; color: #a5a598; } .ds-mix { display: flex; gap: 2px; height: 8px; margin: 6px 0 2px; } .ds-mix i { display: block; min-width: 4px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-mix .req { background: #f1efe8; } .ds-mix .on { background: rgb(241 239 232 / .5); } .ds-mix .off { background: repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(241 239 232 / .55) 0 2px, transparent 2px 5px); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(241 239 232 / .35); }

components.name: Pack Card (active)
components.description: Publisher sidebar row: 16px radius; active is a filled paper block with dark ink (no crop marks).
components.html:
Empi Craft
Forge · MC 1.20.1 · v3
components.css: .ds-pack { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center; width: 270px; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 16px; background: #f1efe8; color: #0b0b0d; } .ds-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 12px; background: #212127; flex: none; } .ds-name { font: 700 14px/1.4 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-sub { font: 11.5px/1.4 'Geist Mono','Cascadia Mono',Consolas,monospace; opacity: .7; }

components.name: Health Pill and Chip
components.description: Publisher pill chips on a faint fill with a hairline; bad turns the border coral.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 10px 3px 8px; border-radius: 999px; font: 500 11.5px/1.4 'Geist Mono','Cascadia Mono',Consolas,monospace; border: 1px solid rgb(241 239 232 / .1); color: #a5a598; background: rgb(255 255 255 / .05); } .ds-bad { border-color: #ff6a4d; }

components.name: Pipeline Dock
components.description: Publisher floating pipeline: 32px radius, min(960px, 100vw - 32px) wide, 16px above the bottom, .95 opaque, circular step numerals. Done is paper, current is a dashed pink outline.

components.css: .ds-dock { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; width: min(560px, 100%); box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 76px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 32px; border: 1px solid rgb(241 239 232 / .1); background: rgb(14 15 17 / .95); box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -20px rgb(0 0 0 / .9), inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .06); } .ds-n { display: grid; place-items: center; flex: none; width: 28px; height: 28px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid #8b8b81; color: #a5a598; font: 700 13px 'Geist Mono','Cascadia Mono',Consolas,monospace; } .ds-done { background: #f1efe8; border-color: #f1efe8; color: #0b0b0d; } .ds-cur { border: 2px dashed #ff3d8b; color: #ff3d8b; } .ds-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-title { font: 600 14px/1.2 'Geist Mono','Cascadia Mono',Consolas,monospace; color: #f1efe8; } .ds-hint { font: 11.5px/1.35 'Geist Mono','Cascadia Mono',Consolas,monospace; color: #a5a598; } .ds-cta { font: 700 13px/1 'Geist Mono','Cascadia Mono',Consolas,monospace; padding: 11px 18px; border: 1px solid #ff3d8b; border-radius: 999px; background: #ff3d8b; color: #16030c; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Resolve Strip and LED
components.description: Publisher dot-progress strip whose dot radius scales with --p (0 to 1) plus the 10px pink LED spinner.
components.css: @keyframes ds-led { 50% { opacity: .2; } } .ds-led-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: #f1efe8; font: 700 14px 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-led { width: 10px; height: 10px; background: #ff3d8b; animation: ds-led 1s steps(1, end) infinite; } .ds-resolve { height: 14px; width: 320px; background: radial-gradient(circle, #f1efe8 calc(var(--p) * 3.6px), transparent calc(var(--p) * 3.6px + .6px)) 0 50% / 12px 14px repeat-x; }

components.description: Launcher version list row on a solid panel: dotted divider, Surface 2 on hover, selected inverted to paper with an ink name, paper-ink description and crop marks inset 3px.

components.name: Launcher Launch Button (states)
components.description: The one action of the launcher and its progress meter: accent notched play; dark plate with rising accent dots while working; red outlined DETENER while running; stipple when disabled.

narrative.overview:
A darkroom bench where a modpack is framed, developed and printed. Ground is near-black, marks are paper-white, and tone is made of halftone dots rather than solid fills. Glitch (a 260 ms scan-line tear with a red/cyan channel split) is how the world speaks about change and failure, and one accent colour is reserved for the next thing the person should do. Text and controls stay crisp and legible; the dithering, ribbing and glitch belong to the ground and to events, never to the words you work in.

In the Publisher the bench is a set of dark translucent modules laid on the living dot ground: the dots read through the module edges and a corner of halftone continues inside each one. Everything you press is a pill or a circle; everything you read sits in a module. Data and chrome are set in Geist Mono, big numerals and the pack name in Doto, reading and input text in Segoe UI Variable. In the launcher the mood stays the original one: square corners, dotted rules, notched launch button. Both surfaces spend motion by doctrine, and the doctrines differ. **The Publisher is alive but budgeted**: a canvas of dots breathes behind the work at 24 fps focused, and every movement must say something. **The launcher is event-only**: nothing moves at rest, one short tear marks a real state change. Low RAM and CPU stay a product principle in both.
keyCharacteristics: Black and paper-white plus exactly one accent. Publisher: pink. Launcher: the modpack's own accent, pink when a pack sets none. The accent means "next action" or "focus".

Publisher: everything is a module (22px), pressables are pills or circles, hairline 1px borders separate; the ground shows through. Launcher: dotted rules, square corners, notched primary, crop marks.
Doto dot-matrix for identity, the pack name and numerals; Geist Mono for Publisher data and chrome; a plain UI face for reading and inputs.
Selection is inversion: a filled paper block (Publisher pack card, tab thumb, pressed icon button, chosen version); the launcher adds crop marks.
Disabled and locked are ordered stipple, never a faded fill.
Publisher motion is alive at rest but budgeted (below); launcher motion is a tear when something happens.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: The accent marks the next action and focus, nothing else. A second accent element competing on screen means one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Flash-Only Channels Rule
rules.body: Red and cyan appear only as short split flashes (260 ms tear, 200 ms Publisher hover split, 260 ms launcher hover split). They are never persistent.

rules.name: The Status Exception Rule
rules.body: Status colours are the only persistent colours outside black, white and the accent, and only for status. Do not extend them to decoration or emphasis.

rules.name: The Paper Ink Rule
rules.body: Text on a paper block is #050506 or #0b0b0d for the main line and #47473f for the sub-line where a sub-line is set; never paper-2 or paper-3, which fail on paper.

rules.name: The Dots Are Headlines Rule
rules.body: Doto is for wordmark, pack name and headings, tile numerals, the drawer title, version numerals and the launch label. It is never body text, labels, buttons (other than the launch label), or inputs, and in the launcher never below 20px. In the Publisher its smallest use is the 19px tile numeral.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule (Publisher)
rules.body: Doto names and counts, Geist Mono reports and labels, Segoe reads and receives typing. Do not set prose in mono or data in Segoe.

rules.name: The Small-Type Floor Rule
rules.body: Launcher text is never below 10px (chips and labels) or 11px (help text and progress). Do not shrink further to fit.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Counts, sizes, versions and progress use `tabular-nums`.

rules.name: The Tinted Shadow Rule (Publisher)
rules.body: Shadows are long, soft, black-tinted and low (modules, dock, drawer). No hard offset shadows, no coloured glows, no blurred card halos. The pink glow around the next action lives in the dot field, not in a box-shadow.

rules.name: The Flat Ground Rule (Launcher)
rules.body: No shadows, glows or blur. Panels are solid.

rules.name: The Ribbed Glass Exception
rules.body: The Publisher topbar's `repeating-linear-gradient` of fine vertical paper lines (7% alpha, 1px lines on a 5px pitch, faded in from the left by a mask) is a deliberate part of the world. Do not remove it, and do not spread it beyond the topbar.

rules.name: The Budgeted Life Rule
rules.body: The Publisher may move at rest only within its budget (see Motion). Backdrop blur, WebGL, video and animated CSS filters stay out.

rules.name: The Says-Something Rule
rules.body: A Publisher movement that does not tell you where you are, what changed or what to do next is removed.

rules.name: The Calm Fallback Rule
rules.body: Every alive movement has a calm equivalent: the same information with no motion, reached by the switch, reduced-motion, or automatic degradation.

dos: Do spend the accent only on the next action, focus, the next stage dot, the running LED and the logo dot (Publisher); on the launch button, focus ring and switched-on toggles (launcher).
Do invert to filled paper (`#f1efe8` on `#0b0b0d`) for selection and pressed state: pack card, tab thumb, pressed icon button, chosen version, on-state switch.
Do build Publisher surfaces as modules (22px, translucent, 1px hairline, halftone corner) and make everything pressable a pill (999px) or a circle (50%); inputs 12px, tiles 16px, zones 20px.
Do set Publisher numbers, hints, tabs, chips, buttons and labels in Geist Mono, names and numerals in Doto, prose and typed text in Segoe.
Do show a share as a hatched bar and a "present but off" state as hatching.

Do make every Publisher movement say where you are, what changed or what to do next, animate transform and opacity (clip-path only for the short arrival and tear), and stay inside the budget (24 fps focused, 10 unfocused, paused hidden, one canvas pixel per CSS pixel).
Do keep the visible motion switch, the `empi.motion` persistence and the reduced-motion calm start.
Do fire the tear only on events, and use the split text-shadow only for hover.

Do keep the launcher square: dotted rules, notched launch button, crop marks on the selected rail entry, per-pack accent, label ink by contrast, banner and background untouched behind the black halftone screens.
Do keep persistent status colours for status only.
donts: Don't add a second accent, gradient fills on controls or coloured glows.
Don't show red or cyan at rest; they exist only inside tear and split flashes.
Don't set Doto on body text, labels, buttons (except the launch label) or inputs, or below 20px in the launcher.
Don't carry Publisher radii, pills or module shadows into the launcher, and don't carry square corners, the notch or crop marks into new Publisher surfaces (the two differ on purpose).
Don't add hard offset shadows or coloured glows anywhere; Publisher shadows stay long, soft and black-tinted.
Don't add backdrop blur, WebGL, video, animated filters or new infinite CSS animations to the Publisher, and no motion at rest in the launcher.
Don't use the accent for DETENER or other stopping actions; the way out is red and outlined.
Don't tint locked or disabled controls with the accent; use the stipple.
Don't remove the topbar's ribbed-glass gradient as a defect, or reuse it elsewhere.
Don't let a halftone plate, the module corner or the dot field sit at full strength behind list text or end in a hard edge.
Don't use status colours for decoration or emphasis.
